bio: I'm a Computer Engineer based in Bergamo, Italy, specialized in embedded software development. I hold a Master's degree in Computer Engineering from the University of Bergamo and have been working in the industry since 2022.

My core expertise is in Embedded Linux - writing C++ applications, building custom Linux distributions with Yocto and Buildroot, and working across the full stack from hardware abstraction to cloud communication. I have experience leading small technical teams and delivering complex software projects in demanding domains.
I enjoy tackling hard technical problems and find satisfaction in building reliable, well-structured systems.
